selected_workflow.delegated_authority: One explicitly approved issue, exact body/AC/source/workflow/profile hashes, destination and authority epoch; claim/publication/review-merge/closure only as enumerated by that manifest.
selected_workflow.stop_recovery: Hold before approval; after admission use existing grant revocation/invalidation and read back the operation. Reserved/active/launch_unknown/unknown-effect states remain incomplete. Reconnect and observe the same operation key; never launch from model text or retry an ambiguous effect. Revocation does not undo committed effects.

required_live_receipts.gate: #5405; current operation is hub-only. A second repository needs its own admission and live qualification before this row can pass.
Read-only #4749 acknowledgement remains distinct from effectful owner acceptance; preserve #5181 platform evidence.

owner_questions.question: Can I identify current work, its exact subject and what evidence is missing?
owner_questions.success: Owner follows Overview to Focus and names the source version and missing evidence without treating a model statement as delivered work.

owner_questions.question: Do I understand what Start authorizes and what Hold leaves unchanged?
owner_questions.success: Owner identifies the exact issue, scope, destination, effects, expiry and epoch before confirming through the existing action boundary.

owner_questions.question: Can I distinguish a technical wait from a decision requiring me?
owner_questions.success: Reserved, unavailable-model and ambiguous-effect cases remain explicit incomplete states; no fabricated owner decision is shown.

owner_questions.question: Can I trace the result to actual effects and try this exact candidate?
owner_questions.success: Owner follows host effect receipts and independent GitHub readback to current candidate/readiness/profile evidence, then records a separate trial.

owner_questions.question: Is the explanation useful and do I explicitly accept the tested criterion scope?
owner_questions.success: Owner records observations and an explicit accepted/rejected outcome bound to the current candidate and profile. Automated fixture success cannot answer this question.

scenarios.normal: Overview/Focus -> source-linked synthesis -> exact Start -> protected existing workflow -> independent actual readback -> readiness -> separate trial -> separate owner decision.
scenarios.owner_decision: Confirm Start/Hold against the exact preview; separately confirm tried/unable_to_try and accepted/rejected through FCA-09. No model action text supplies either authority.
scenarios.technical_wait: Reserve without entering the worker; show waiting/incomplete, observe without spawning or asking for invented owner authority.
scenarios.stale_or_contradictory: Withdraw current acceptance on source/head/candidate/profile/epoch/receipt drift, missing component, conflicting selection or changed evidence during readback.
scenarios.model_unavailable: Keep usable source facts and label model failure. Do not activate providers or billing fallback; live usefulness remains unobserved.
scenarios.ambiguous_start: Lose the response after entry, read launch_unknown and the same operation key, retain the fence and do not redispatch.
scenarios.client_disconnected: Show incomplete while disconnected. Reconnect by rereading receipts/current bindings; no client memory is authority.
scenarios.revoked: Revoke the host grant before the next proposed effect; preserve prior claim evidence, refuse new effect and observe recovery state.

residual_limits: Harness transport doubles do not prove live GitHub/provider/systemd/VM102 effects or operating-system isolation.
